storage: Airtight jar, cool dark place, dry spoon every time. Do not store near the stove.
looksLike: A dark brown to near-black, fine powder with a tangy, roasted-spice smell.
howToPick: Sealed pack, fresh dark colour and strong aroma; avoid clumps (moisture) or a flat smell. Check the label for onion/garlic powder or hing with wheat if relevant.
shelfLife: About 6 to 12 months unopened; best within a few months of opening (general guidance; not from a source in this run).
substitutes: Garam masala + amchur (about 3:1) + a pinch of chilli
Pav bhaji or chana masala-style blends from the same brand
Homemade roasted blend (coriander, cumin, black cardamom, cloves, anardana, amchur)
